stops.note: named the red dye extracted from the seeds of a tropical shrub
the red seed dye was used by Caribbean peoples as body paint and later colours cheeses like Red Leicester
stops.meaning: a red dye made from tropical shrub seeds

stops.note: borrowed into English through colonial trade accounts
stops.meaning: a natural orange-red food coloring and seasoning

current_meaning: a natural orange-red dye and seasoning derived from the seeds of the annatto shrub, used in cheeses and traditional cooking
